[06/03/21 01:28 AM] Annelies Gamble: It’s not always about growth at all costs. After closing Seed rounds, I sometimes see companies start spending aggressively on paid marketing in order to hit huge growth ahead of an A. This is a mistake if you can’t measure attribution and quickly identify what’s not working. 1/3
It's more important to grow thoughtfully, which means investing in your product and infrastructure ahead of paid marketing. 2/3
Once you do start investing in paid marketing, having the ability to track attribution and longer-term engagement across each separate channel is key. The goal should be to show early signals of building a repeatable machine. 3/3

[08/31/21 12:52 AM] Annelies Gamble: So I didn’t look at it but I talked to my friend at BoxGroup who did and she passed. Her thoughts were basically that Palla’s UI and distribution are innovative (white label for neobanks and riding the coattails of their banking partners’ growth). But she passed because there is no innovation on the underlying rails technology, and thus there is no cost advantage. It seems like the sender, who decides which remittance platform to use, is going to choose whichever one is the cheapest. She felt like Palla would be like investing in a brand on top of commodity rails. Fwiw, another YC co in this batch is Instakin (https://instakin.com/), which is also using existing rails and innovating by building a task rabbit on top so senders don’t have to worry that their families aren’t spending the money correctly

[08/02/22 09:02 PM] Annelies Gamble: +tThanks so much Will! This is very helpful

In case of interest, this is what I found out from a few ppl I talked to:
The biggest factor for comps for devs is RAM. At our eng agency, they used to try and be cheap but found it wasn't worth it. 32GB of Ram is what you should be getting devs if you want to keep the computers for more than 2-3 years.

According to our eng agency, Macs are unquestionably the best. And $3k is a rough budget according. Attached is the computer that they buy their engineers.

However, some devs are more comfortable using Windows or Linux. Budget for those is cheaper: $1.5-2k.
It's very, very bad to force devs to use Windows/Linux if they're used to using Macs. And vice versa. According to our head of eng, some devs will refuse to work with you if you don't give them the OS they're used to.
Specific specs for Mac vs PCs:

Mac
Disk : 512 GB
RAM : 16 GB at least (32 GB could be an option if we think of keeping them more than 2-3 years)
Chip: M1 PRO
Display : 16"

PC/Laptop
Disk: 512 GB
RAM: 32GB at least (Windows runs slower than MAC so it needs more RAM)
Chip: Core i7 / AMD Ryzen 7
Display: 14" - 16"iIt

[03/15/23 10:14 PM] Jordan: +What do you think is the secret to a happy relationship or marriage?

Really carving out the time for each other. We all struggle with it. There’s so much to balance. There’s so much to do. And you find yourself running and doing the things for school, for the kids, and doing all the things for your lists, for all the dreams you have in your career, and what you have to do next. That time together with you and your partner is so priceless. And to carve out that time and to make that important, as important as those daily things, I think it really pours back into the relationship. You remember why you are in love, you remember why you just like each other, what’s interesting about each other. iI
